stem: Draw the line passing through the two points $(1, -1)$ and $(4, 0)$. Drag the two handles onto these points.

hints.text: Read each pair as (x, y) when you place the handles; the gradient is change in y over change in x.
Place one handle at each named point; the line through them is the answer.

notes: Book answer has b=-4/3, so points mode used.
